Several days (Mimar Haffar and Maior Domus: 20 h cooldown; Phosphorus: 2 days and 20 h)

{npc:Wayland Smythers}, in Venore, asks you to free his mentor, {npc:Doctor Marrow (NPC)|Doctor Marrow}, imprisoned in {wiki:Thalassara|Thalassara}, the kingdom where a fragment of the moon fell. You sneak aboard a supply ship, earn the trust of Salgadara, infiltrate the moonsilver cult and defeat the quest's three bosses — {creature:Mimar Haffar}, {creature:Maior Domus} and the false god {creature:Phosphorus}. The rewards come from the bosses' loot: the {wiki:Moonsilver Set|Moonsilver Set}, the {item:Cloud In a Bottle} (Radiant Nimbus mount), scraps for the {wiki:Illuminated Warrior Outfits|Illuminated Warrior Outfits}, several titles and access to crafting the Stellar Moonsilver weapons.

The distant realm of Thalassara is an isolated domain that recently rose to prominence when a fragment of the moon fell there. What began as a rush for newly discovered moonsilver soon turned into something far more unsettling. Throughout the quest you will deal with suspicious factions, strange cult activity and the consequences of forces that perhaps should have been left alone. Expect investigation, infiltration, exploration, puzzles and a journey that takes you from a besieged frontier settlement to places few have ever seen.
Wayland Smythers, next to the Venore temple (1 floor up)

Minimum level **300**; the recommended level is **800+**. The bosses of this quest are the hardest in the game so far (the update aims it at players who have done the {wiki:Rotten Blood Quest}, the {wiki:Soul War Quest} and the {wiki:Primal Ordeal Quest}, but they are not mandatory).
You do not need any previous quest or special access: getting into {wiki:Thalassara|Thalassara} is part of the quest itself (section 1).

A **mixed team**: for {creature:Mimar Haffar} you need people on two floors and a {wiki:Paladin} or {wiki:Knight} on the lower floor; for {creature:Maior Domus} the plates only charge if there are kills made by Knights/Monks **and** by Paladins/Druids/Sorcerers; for {creature:Phosphorus} each Rival hits vocations other than its own harder. The wiki does not give the maximum number of players per room.
Moonsilver helmets require level **800** and Moonsilver weapons level **1000** before you can use them.
to stop the Moonsilver Custodians at Mimar Haffar
alternative to Magic Wall for blocking the Custodians
Plenty of health and mana potions: the fights are long and the damage is high.
a guaranteed way back to the temple, since the wiki does not document the return boat from Thalassara (see section 9)
**Holy** damage (Paladin) to kill the {creature:Trapped Soul|Trapped Souls}, which only take holy damage.
{wiki:Moonsilver Set|Moonsilver Set} (helmets and weapons for every vocation), from boss loot only
from difficulty 15; tames the Radiant Nimbus mount
from difficulty 5 (Mimar/Phosphorus) or 7 (Maior Domus); traded for the Illuminated Warrior Outfits
Phosphorus (Final) loot; needed for Stellar crafting
Guaranteed titles **Lamp Breaker**, **Pit Fighter** and **Light Reaver**; optional titles **Djinn Dominator** and **Eclipse Bringer** (difficulty 20+)
Access to crafting the {wiki:Moonsilver Set|Stellar Moonsilver} weapons with {npc:Wayland Smythers}
Experience: 3,500,000 for Mimar Haffar, 3,500,000 for Maior Domus and 16,000,000 for Phosphorus (Final)
Section 1: after crossing {npc:Wayland Smythers}'s warehouse in Venore disguised as a crate.
Section 5: by defeating {creature:Mimar Haffar}, you and your team gain access to the cult base, south-west of Thalassara.
The Radiant Skyhold is also an XP hunting ground (no loot).
Section 7: by killing {creature:Maior Domus}, who guards the spiritual key to the inner sanctum.
It is also an XP hunting ground (no loot).
Final room with Wayland Smythers and teleports to all the bosses
Section 9: after defeating {creature:Phosphorus} for the first time (on any difficulty).
After finishing the quest: say {key:craft} to {npc:Wayland Smythers} in the final room.
Each victory against a boss unlocks the next difficulty, per character.
With the Make Believe Quest completed you can exchange 2,500 {item:Scraps of a Radiant Attire} for the base outfit (and 1,250 for each addon).
With a {item:Cloud In a Bottle}, which the bosses drop from difficulty 15 onwards.

The three bosses use the {wiki:Boss Difficulty System|Boss Difficulty System}: after pulling the lever you choose the difficulty in a dedicated window. **Difficulty 1** is a learning mode (no boss loot or Bosstiary progress, and you take 50% less damage). The mechanics in this guide are those of difficulty 1.
Each character unlocks the difficulties on their own (you have to beat the previous one), so the team moves up together.
Cooldowns: {creature:Mimar Haffar} 20 h; {creature:Maior Domus} 20 h (15 min fight at most); {creature:Phosphorus} 2 days and 20 h (20 min fight at most).
To reward persistence, your chance of getting new Moonsilver equipment increases until you get a piece.
{creature:Moonspawn Juggernaut} is **immune to Earth** and takes 105% fire damage: druids, bring another source of damage.
Before the fights, agree on who does what: at Mimar Haffar there is one team upstairs (miners and crystals) and another downstairs (souls and cannons).

The quest starts in Venore. Wayland Smythers is looking for heroes to face the creatures that fell from the moon and free his mentor, Doctor Marrow. He smuggles you onto a supply ship bound for Thalassara.
Go to **Venore** (for example by boat from Thais: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}) and look for {npc:Wayland Smythers} **next to the temple**, 1 floor above the ground.

Say {key:hi} and follow the conversation in this order: {key:danger}, {key:hear}, {key:Marrow}, {key:spherequake}, {key:moonsilver}, {key:Thalassara}, {key:headstart}, {key:threat}, {key:reputation}, {key:align}, {key:entity}, {key:find}, {key:proceed}, {key:captive}, {key:stronghold} and {key:further}. He explains that Doctor Marrow was captured by an entity in Thalassara and asks whether you will help him.

Answer {key:yes}, then say {key:infiltration}. Wayland gives you access to the hidden warehouse in Venore where the ships for Thalassara are loaded: you have to disguise yourself as a cargo crate, evade the guards and reach the loading area. When he asks whether you are ready to cross the warehouse, answer {key:yes}.
The wiki gives no coordinates for the warehouse: Wayland himself grants access during this conversation.
In the warehouse, **click the crate** at the entrance to disguise yourself as a cargo crate. The goal is to reach the **north-west** part of the room.
The Venore warehouse: cross it to the teleport in the north-west
Cross the warehouse without getting caught

Keep moving north-west without getting within melee range (1 sqm) of the guards, or you will be caught. **Do not stand still**: if you stay on the same sqm for too long, your character sneezes and you are discovered. Watch out for some **grate sqm**, which make noise when you step on them and reveal your position to nearby guards.
Three things give you away: being within a guard's melee range, sneezing from standing still and stepping on a noisy grate.
When you reach the **north-west** area, enter the teleport. After a short animated cutscene you arrive in {wiki:Thalassara|Thalassara}.

This entrance is one-way only. The wiki does not yet document any return boat from Thalassara to the mainland: in Salgadara there is an NPC with a captain's title, {npc:Captain Corsarah}, but her routes are not described. See section 9 for how to get back to your temple and how to return to Thalassara later.
In Thalassara you have to prove to the mayor of Salgadara that you are not just another moonsilver hunter.
From where you arrive, walk **south-east** and go up some stairs to the village of {wiki:Salgadara|Salgadara}, where {npc:Mayor Pocaro} is, 1 floor above the ground.

Say {key:hi} to {npc:Mayor Pocaro} and offer your help (the wiki does not transcribe this conversation; follow the words highlighted by the NPC). He asks you to prove your intentions by defending Salgadara in the next Moonspawn attack.

The attack happens nearby, **east** of the village. It is a raid that repeats every **30 minutes**: first a few Moonspawn creatures appear and, after a while, the {creature:Moonspawn Juggernaut} shows up.
Kill the {creature:Moonspawn Juggernaut} (60,000 HP, melee attacks). All players who took part in the kill receive a quest log update.
**It is immune to earth**; it takes 105% fire damage, 85% ice and energy and 65% death.

Go back to {npc:Mayor Pocaro} and report the victory. He tells you that the fishermen saw suspicious figures in white robes near the fallen rock and suggests that you disguise yourself as one of them to infiltrate and find out where Doctor Marrow is.
The moonsilver cult roams the south of Thalassara. You need a disguise taken from one of its initiates.
Go to the **south** of Thalassara, to the region called **Recifar**. This is where the {creature:Cult Initiate|Cult Initiates} roam.
Kill a {creature:Cult Initiate} (10,000 HP, melee attacks).
**Use the corpse** of the Cult Initiate to disguise yourself as a cult member.
Once disguised, enter the teleport to the south.

In the room there is a {item:Gong}, three coloured sqm and a book to the **north**. Use the gong and watch the sparks that appear around the book: memorise the **order of the colours**. Once the whole sequence has been shown, repeat it using the devices **just north of the coloured sqm**. If you get it right, all players in the room receive a quest log update.
Write the sequence down on paper or in the party chat before repeating it.

Leave the room, follow a path to the **south-east** and enter a teleport that takes you inside the crater (**Moonstone Crater**). Once inside, go **south** and up the stairs to the first boss's lever.

Mimar Haffar is trapped in the middle of the lower floor, invulnerable behind an invisible barrier. He does not move, but attacks anyone who comes close. The fight has two phases that take place at the same time on two floors. Cooldown: 20 h.
Pull the lever and choose the difficulty
Gather the team and pull the lever. The {wiki:Boss Difficulty System|Boss Difficulty System} window opens: choose the difficulty (1 is the learning mode) and start the fight from that window.
Difficulty selection window before the fight against Mimar Haffar

Split the team between the **upper floor** and the **lower floor**. The {wiki:Paladin|Paladin(s)} or {wiki:Knight|Knight(s)} stay **downstairs** to deal with the {creature:Trapped Soul|Trapped Souls}. In the south of the room there is a {item:Holy Portal|holy portal} that leads to the upper floor; the portals have a **30-second cooldown**, so plan your trips back and forth carefully.
Lower floor: stop the Trapped Souls

The {creature:Trapped Soul|Trapped Souls} wander around randomly for a while and eventually make their way to the boss: each one that reaches him gives him **one charge** and each charge makes him stronger. They are slow, have little HP (1,450) and are **immune to everything except holy**, so the Paladins kill them. Alternatively, a Knight uses {spell:Challenge} on them and leads them **north**, next to the large lunar essence tanks, where they disappear (the character gets a counter that goes down every few seconds and heals them; the effect is not yet well understood).

Every now and then a soul becomes unstable (*The soul is becoming unstable!*) and explodes **2 seconds later** in a small radius, taking **25% of maximum HP** as {wiki:Agony Damage|Agony Damage}. Move away at once.

Upstairs, kill the {creature:Moonstone Miner|Moonstone Miners} (16,500 HP) and pick up the {item:Moonsilver Crystals} they drop. Take the crystals downstairs through the portal or **drop them on the teleports to the west and east**, which send them to the lower floor.
Upper floor: stop the Moonsilver Custodians

Over time, the rooms where the {creature:Moonsilver Custodian|Moonsilver Custodians} are locked up open; they head for the teleports to go down and help the boss. Block their way by standing in front of them or with {item:Magic Wall Rune|Magic Walls} and {item:Wild Growth Rune|Wild Growths}. You can also let them through if the team downstairs can handle them.
Lower floor: charge the Energy Cannons

There are two {creature:Energy Cannon|Energy Cannons}, in the **south-west** and **south-east** of the room. Use the {item:Moonsilver Crystals} on the cannons: each crystal gives **10 charges**, so each cannon needs **10 crystals** to reach 100 charges.
The crystals disappear shortly after they are dropped: use them quickly.

When **both** cannons reach 100 charges they become {creature:Energy Cannon (Charged)|Charged Cannons} and fire at the boss's defences: Mimar Haffar is freed and **vulnerable for 45 seconds**. The whole team hits him during that time. When the time runs out he returns to his trapped position and phase 1 starts again. Repeat until he dies (460,000 HP).

Mimar Haffar loot: {item:Moonsilver Battle Visor}, {item:Moonsilver Spirit Mask}, {item:Figurine of Mimar Haffar} (rare), {item:Dirty Turban}; scraps from difficulty 5 upwards; title **Lamp Breaker**.
The wiki does not describe the way out of the boss room or the crater: go back the way you came in. The next step is the cult base, south-west of Thalassara (section 5).
By defeating Mimar Haffar, you and your team gain access to the cult base, the Radiant Skyhold.
Go to the cult base, **south-west** of Thalassara. Go in, walk **south** and use the teleport to the **east**.
Make your way through the room until you find {npc:Doctor Marrow (NPC)|Doctor Marrow}, locked in a cell (you cannot reach him, only talk to him).

Say {key:hi}, {key:capable}, {key:prison} and then {key:explain}, and carry on: {key:samples}, {key:interaction}, {key:believers}, {key:purpose}, {key:CREATION}, {key:failure}, {key:god}, {key:unpleasant}, {key:stopped}, {key:traitor}, {key:abomination}, {key:hesitate} and {key:helping}. He explains that the cult he himself led gave shape to a true god, who imprisoned him, and sends you to kill **Maior Domus**, the traitorous butler who guards the spiritual key to the inner sanctum. He also promises to hide you from the god's eye while you cross the palace.
If you talk to him again, {key:explain} repeats the explanation.
Go up to Maior Domus's room

The lever room of {creature:Maior Domus} is **5 floors above** the entrance of the {wiki:Radiant Skyhold|Radiant Skyhold}. The way is full of strong radiant creatures: {creature:Radiant Warden|Radiant Wardens}, {creature:Radiant Paragon|Radiant Paragons} and {creature:Radiant Acolyte|Radiant Acolytes}.
After 3,000 kills of normal creatures in the Radiant Skyhold, all the remaining ones turn into their **Devoted** versions (more HP and stronger) for 1 hour.

Maior Domus fights alongside several Moonsilver Guardians. While he has the yellow shield, he heals about 23,000 HP for every hit he takes. The fight has two phases. Cooldown: 20 h; maximum duration: 15 minutes.

Pull the lever and choose the difficulty in the {wiki:Boss Difficulty System|Boss Difficulty System} window. {creature:Maior Domus} and several {creature:Moonsilver Guardian|Moonsilver Guardians} appear in the room.
Yellow shield: the boss heals ~23,000 for every hit

Kill the {creature:Moonsilver Guardian|Moonsilver Guardians} (10,600 HP). They have an area heal they use regularly, so **separate them**: together they are hard to kill if the team has little damage. Each guardian killed adds 1 to one of two types of charge, depending on the vocation that dealt **the most damage** to it:
Goes up when most damage was dealt by
When all three plates are charged, the guardians disappear and phase 2 begins.
Phase 2: do not hit the yellow shield
From now until the end of the fight, **do not hit the boss while he has the yellow shield**: each hit heals him 23,000 and ruins your progress.
Watch out for area runes and spells that hit the boss by accident.

One player stands on one of the charged plates to activate it. At that moment a random character becomes {wiki:Powerless|Powerless} for 8 seconds (magic icon with a counter from 8 to 0, which heals them ~1,000 per second). When the counter ends, they explode in a small {wiki:Agony Damage|Agony} explosion (5,500–8,500) that also hurts the boss.
Magic icon with the Powerless counter

When you activate a plate, Maior Domus becomes **vulnerable for 20 seconds** (the yellow shield is replaced by a white 'X'): this is the moment to hit him with everything. Whoever is standing on the plates gets **+20 skill** (red shield icon). When the time runs out, the boss teleports to the middle of the room, gets his shield back and the plate that was used is deactivated.
Red shield: +20 skill while standing on the plate
Move on to the next plate

Repeat with the next plate until you have used all the charged plates. **Everyone** must step off the used plate before you activate the next one: if someone stays on a deactivated plate, the next one will not activate. When all the plates have been used, phase 1 starts again; repeat the cycle until Maior Domus dies.
Maior Domus loot: {item:Moonsilver Strike Helm}, {item:Moonsilver Trail Hood}, {item:Figurine of Maior Domus} (rare); scraps from difficulty 7 upwards; title **Pit Fighter**.
With Maior Domus dead you have the key to the inner sanctum (Radiant Ascendancy). Before the god, there is a room with six fanatics.
Leave Maior Domus's room and go through the teleports to the **north**. Enter the room and pull the lever: six {creature:Elite Fanatic|Elite Fanatics} appear.
Teleports to the Elite Fanatics room
The {creature:Elite Fanatic|Elite Fanatics} heal each other a lot, so **separate them**. When one of them drops to about **40%** HP, it turns into a {creature:Petrified Fanatic}.
Push the Petrified Fanatics onto the special sqm
Push each {creature:Petrified Fanatic} until it is standing on a {item:Medium Richly Ornamented Floor (Lit)|richly ornamented floor}. Petrified Fanatics can be pushed like any other object.
When **all** the Petrified Fanatics are on the special sqm, an **orange** teleport appears in the **north** part of the room. Enter it to reach the final boss's lever room.

The final battle has three consecutive phases: Phosphorus, then the final forms of Maior Domus and Mimar Haffar, and finally Phosphorus (Final). Cooldown: 2 days and 20 h; maximum duration: 20 minutes.

Pull the lever and choose the difficulty. {creature:Phosphorus} starts **invulnerable** and appears with several {creature:Moonsilver Protector|Moonsilver Protectors}. Clear the Protectors when you can, but the focus is the pedestal mechanic.

The room has five 3x4 sqm areas, each with the pedestals of one {wiki:Vocation|vocation}. Shortly after the start, the boss teleports to one of these areas and a **Rival** appears in the **north** part of the room. Pull the boss off the pedestals he went to, lead the Rival to the area with the **pedestal of its vocation** and kill it there. Rivals deal extra damage to vocations other than their own. The order is always the same:

If you kill the Rival in the right place, *YOU CONVERTED THE ENERGY!* appears. If you kill it outside its pedestal area, *YOU FAILED TO CONVERT THE POWER!* appears and the boss gains **one charge** (magic icon with a counter), becoming stronger and taking less damage. There is a progress counter on the **north** wall.
Each Rival killed in the wrong place makes the boss harder until the end of the phase.

After **5 Rivals** have been killed successfully, the boss teleports to the **north** of the room and becomes **vulnerable for 40 seconds**. The messages mark the time: *THE TEST BEGINS NOW!* (start), *THE TEST IS NEARLY OVER* (20 s left), *THE TEST ENDS NOW!* (5 s left) and *IT STARTS AGAIN!* (end). Then he becomes invulnerable again and you repeat the Rival cycle.

Repeat the cycle until the boss escapes (*PHOSPHORUS ESCAPED - CHASE AFTER HIM!*). An {item:Ice Portal} appears (*A TELEPORTER HAS APPEARED!*) on the **east** side of the room. This portal **must be used** (click it); stepping onto it is not enough. The first player to use it takes **the whole team** to the next room and phase 2 begins.
Phase 2: Maior Domus (Final) in the centre

{creature:Maior Domus (Final)} is already in the arena, while {creature:Mimar Haffar (Final)} stays outside it casting random spells. 4 {creature:Moonsilver Sentinel|Moonsilver Sentinels} appear and respawn when they die. Maior Domus **does not respect** {spell:Challenge}, but he has no special heals or shields: you can simply kill him. **Keep him around the centre of the room.**

If Maior Domus leaves the centre, Mimar prepares a spell (*The middle of the room is charging up!*) and 3 seconds later an energy explosion of 3,000+ (*The clashing auras trigger a devastating explosion!*) hits the centre. This repeats until Maior returns to the centre. Some of Mimar's special attacks also give charges to Maior, who becomes stronger (and so do the Sentinels).
Phase 2: watch out for the Storms

The room starts with two invulnerable {creature:Storm (Moonsilver)|Storms} that wander around randomly; one more appears for each boss that reaches 50% HP (up to 4). The Storms cast area spells that leave you {wiki:Rooted|rooted} for 5 seconds, and the effect is renewed if you are hit again before it ends, so you can be stuck for a long time. Each new Storm gives the bosses a charge (magic icon).

When Maior Domus dies, {creature:Mimar Haffar (Final)} enters the arena. He **respects** {spell:Challenge} and starts with 5 charges (up-arrow icon) that make him stronger. From time to time he casts an {wiki:Agony Damage|Agony} spell (1,500+) at his target that explodes in an area; each Storm hit by it explodes around itself with 2,000+ energy damage, and several Storms at once cause a huge damage spike. Keep the target away from the Storms.

Mimar can be attacked throughout the phase, even from outside the arena, with ranged attacks. If time is not an issue, killing Mimar **before** Maior means there are at most 3 Storms when he dies (fewer damage spikes) and stops him from coming down with the 5 charges.
With Mimar Haffar dead, another {item:Ice Portal} appears (*A TELEPORTER HAS APPEARED!*) on the **east** side of the room. The first player to use it takes the whole team to the final room.

{creature:Phosphorus (Final)} **does not respect** {spell:Challenge} and can cast {wiki:Fear|Fear} on his targets. Throughout the fight: {creature:Disruptive Energy|Disruptive Energies} appear at random, live for 4 seconds and explode with energy damage in a small area if a player is nearby (move away); and {item:Sanctified Draining Rift|Sanctified Draining Rifts} appear on the floor, which disappear when stepped on but take about **40% of your HP** as {wiki:Agony Damage|Agony}, damage that ignores {wiki:Mana Shield|Mana Shield}, {wiki:Barrier|Barrier} and {wiki:Gift of Life|Gift of Life} (do not step on them).

Regularly, a character is cursed (*You have been cursed.*, with a Death Effect and an up-arrow icon with a counter next to the name). The counter goes up by 1 per second and each second takes **10% of maximum HP** as Agony, up to 8; then the curse ends with one more hit of 25–30% of maximum HP. This damage **ignores** {wiki:Mana Shield|Mana Shield}, {wiki:Barrier|Barrier} and {wiki:Gift of Life|Gift of Life}. At the same time a {item:Shimmering Field} appears somewhere in the room: the cursed character must **step on it at once**, which cleanses the curse (*The curse fades as you enter the field.*).
If you do not reach the Shimmering Field, the curse can take more than 100% of your HP in total.
Put it all together: run from the Disruptive Energies, do not step on the rifts, cleanse the curses and hit the boss until he dies.

Phosphorus (Final) loot: {item:Moonsilver Claymore}, {item:Moonsilver Epee}, {item:Moonsilver Sceptre}, {item:Moonsilver Channeler}, {item:Moonsilver Bow}, {item:Moonsilver Katar}, {item:Figurine of Phosphorus}, {item:Auric Moon Sigil}; 16,000,000 experience; title **Light Reaver**.

When you defeat Phosphorus (on any difficulty) you receive a quest log update and gain access to a teleport to the **south-west**, on the **ground floor**. There you meet {npc:Wayland Smythers} again and find **shortcut teleports to all the bosses** of the quest, for future runs.

Say {key:craft} to {npc:Wayland Smythers} in the final room to make a **Stellar Moonsilver** weapon (stronger; it does not drop from any boss). You must have in your backpack **3 weapons of the same type**, one from each set, all **without a tier** (tier 0), and an {item:Auric Moon Sigil}:
1 Sanguine weapon of the same type (tier 0)
1 Moonsilver weapon of the same type (tier 0)

The wiki **does not document** any boat or teleport back from Thalassara to the mainland. In {wiki:Salgadara|Salgadara} there is an NPC with a captain's title, {npc:Captain Corsarah}, but the wiki does not yet describe her routes (you can try {key:hi} and see what she offers). The guaranteed way back is to use a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} (from the Daily Reward) or the Store's Temple Teleport, which take you to your city's temple.
The Temple Teleport Scroll does not work in No-Logout zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block: leave combat and wait for the block to end before using it.
Return to Thalassara to repeat the bosses

To come back later, {npc:Captain Fearless}, in Venore's north harbour, has **Thalassara** in his list of destinations for **500 gp** ({key:hi}, {key:thalassara}, {key:yes}). The wiki does not say whether he only takes you after you have made the stowaway trip from section 1. Once in Thalassara, after beating Phosphorus, use the **shortcut teleports** in Wayland Smythers's room to go straight to each boss.
Cooldowns: {creature:Mimar Haffar} and {creature:Maior Domus} 20 h; {creature:Phosphorus} 2 days and 20 h.

After your first victory against Phosphorus you have your own room with Wayland Smythers and shortcuts to all the bosses. This section also explains how to leave Thalassara and how to return to repeat the fights.

**Difficulties and what they change** (summary of the {wiki:Boss Difficulty System|Boss Difficulty System}): for each level above 1, the team takes +10% damage, monsters have +5% HP and loot goes up by 2%. Difficulty 5 (Mimar, Phosphorus) / 7 (Maior): {item:Scraps of a Radiant Attire} are added. Difficulty 10: new mechanics (Mimar: players can be teleported to the other floor at random, with the message *You feel a magical force pushing you upward.* or *pulling you downward.* 4–15 s beforehand; Maior: guardians spawn next to the plates, two curses at a time and stepping on the plates roots you; Phosphorus: Protectors also during the damage phase, Sentinels leave fields that strengthen the Storms, more rifts). Difficulty 15: the {item:Cloud In a Bottle} is added. Difficulty 20: titles **Djinn Dominator** (Mimar), **Armor Breaker** (Maior) and **Eclipse Bringer** (Phosphorus). Difficulty 25: Mimar with barriers breaking more often and Custodians that explode; Maior with guardians that have a death effect and charged plates that deal percentage damage; Phosphorus with room-wide spells (Holy 20,000+ on the glass sqm every 10 s, Death 25,000+ on the black sqm every 15 s) and better chances of an {item:Auric Moon Sigil}.

**Moonsilver Set**: helmets ({item:Moonsilver Battle Visor} Knight, {item:Moonsilver Trail Hood} Paladin, {item:Moonsilver Spirit Mask} Druid, {item:Moonsilver Nimbus Hat} Sorcerer, {item:Moonsilver Strike Helm} Monk; level 800) and weapons (Axe, Chopper, Claymore, Crusher, Epee, Mace, Bow, Crossbow, Sceptre, Channeler and Katar; level 1000). They can only be obtained as loot from this quest's bosses.
**Illuminated Warrior Outfits**: once the quest is complete, trade 2,500 {item:Scraps of a Radiant Attire} for the base outfit and 1,250 for each addon (see {wiki:Illuminated Warrior Outfits Quest}).
**Radiant Nimbus**: use the {item:Cloud In a Bottle} to tame the {wiki:Radiant Nimbus (Mount)|Radiant Nimbus} mount (+10 speed) and earn the **Radiant Nimbus** achievement.
The {wiki:Radiant Skyhold|Radiant Skyhold} and the {wiki:Radiant Ascendancy|Radiant Ascendancy} are hunting grounds made for XP: the creatures drop no loot or money.
There is a dedicated ranking, the **Phosphorus Record**, with the highest difficulty each player has completed against Phosphorus.
